explanation: Fires on words that name or locate a place in the outdoor landscape: water and terrain nouns (river, sea, ocean, coast, bay, lake, gulf, channel, desert, valley, mountain, hill, shore) and compass or side modifiers of a region (north, south, western, southeastern, central, left, steep, edge, side, heart). It is strongest (about 2.5 to 4) when the word ends a locative or motion phrase such as 'on the north bank of the river', 'neared the coast' or 'swam in the river', and the following ' the' and head noun stay partly active. Indoor and household places (room, kitchen, sofa, garage, office) mostly stay below 1, with some (bed, desk, chair, sink) at 1.1 to 1.3. Many other nouns give weak firing near the line (letter, proposal, correlation, cup up to about 2), and the word piece ' pat' fires (about 2). Text with no nouns (conversational sentences, code, number lists) stays below 1, except that the verbs ' walked' and ' hear' reached about 1.0 to 1.1.
